values.note: Book online (Let's Camp) or by phone at the front gate from May 1; the park office takes bookings up to a year ahead. All nights are paid on arrival; cancel at least 2 days ahead. A booking fee applies. The A loop is seasonal (full service); the B and C loops are sold by the night.

values.note: 2025 rates, GST included: electric (30 A) C$35 a night or C$210 a week; non-electric tent sites C$26. A booking fee applies (amount not posted). Park entry C$5 a car a day. Full-service seasonal sites C$3,605 (May 1 - September 30).

note: Regional park 2 km north of Rosthern off Hwy 11, beside its 18-hole golf course; treed sites, a zip line and long slide in the playground, and camp kitchens. The A loop holds the seasonal full-service sites; the B and C loops are sold by the night. --Claude

C$35 electric (2025, GST in), entry C$5/car/day; electric 50 -> 30, water/sewer false (nightly sites). Not waterfront kept. Pin OK.
